question:
**Direction: Each of the following sentences in this section has a blank space and four words or a group of words given after the sentence. Select the word or group of words you consider most appropriate for the blank space and indicate your response on the Answer Sheet accordingly.**

The dress isn't really tight. It'll ______ when you've worn it.
solution:
The correct answer is 'stretch.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us see the meanings of the given options:

 
 
• Bend: **to make something that was straight into a curved shapeमोड़ना, झुकाना, टेढ़ा करना)
 
• **Expand: **to become or to make something bigger. (फैलना या फैलाना)
 
• **Squeeze: **to press something hard for a particular purpose. ((विशेष प्रयोजन से) किसी वस्‍तु को कसकर दबाना)
 
• **Stretch: **to pull something so that it becomes longer or wider; to become longer or wider in this way. (किसी वस्‍तु को अधिक लंबा या चौड़ा करने के लिए खींचना; (किसी वस्‍तु का) खिंच कर अधिक लंबा या चौड़ा हो जाना, बढ़ जाना, तनन)
 
 

 
• The sentence states that the dress doesn't fit tightly at all. When he wears it, it will become longer or wider.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

​Correct sentence: *The dress isn't really tight. It'll **stretch**__ when you've worn it.*
